title: Lost money: Roman coins found in England, reign by reign
excerpt: 275,206 Roman coins recorded by the Portable Antiquities Scheme, mapped district by district and reign by reign. The coin curve is the classic one. The map of it is a step, not a slope.
seo_description: 275,206 Roman coin finds mapped across England by district and reign, from the Portable Antiquities Scheme.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Lost money: Roman coins found in England, reign by reign' beside a map of English districts shaded from pale gold to dark brown.
